Name: AT More Doors - PIF
Author: electroslime
Description:
[center]Just a Mini mod I made in between work.

This mod allows you to retexture the "Personal rooms" doors with a few fun new additions
The mod requires Alternative Textures and PIF. It can be accessible in the "Happy home Designer" as well.

Perks of this mod:
-New doors! (18 retexture options)
-Made with Multiplayers in mind but can be used in single player too

This mod adds a selection of "stair replacements" and doors. These replacements can be used for multiplayer farmers who don't have access to their upstairs or downstairs in custom farm houses. The stair replacements are drawn to fill up the whole space leaving no gaps in place. If placing them is an Issue I highly recommend the "anything anywhere" mod

I do have plan to make "single doors" for the smaller frames but it will have to come later
feel free to suggest door aesthetics in post. i draw and make everything myself so i'll do my best (ex magical, cottage core, dungeon etc etc etc)
